title: Security
subtitle: A second step at sign-in keeps your admin yours, even if someone learns your password.
alone: Your admin signs in with the password alone. Turn on a second step to protect it.
app.line: A 6-digit code from an app on your phone at each sign-in.
app.off.askLast: Turn off the authenticator app? Nothing else is on: your password alone will sign in, and your recovery codes stop working.
passkeys.ip: Passkeys need this admin at a domain name, such as localhost, not an IP address.
passkeys.browser: This browser offers no passkeys on this page. Use an authenticator app instead.
passkeys.line: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
passkey.add.ask: Add a passkey on this device
passkey.cancelled: No passkey was added. Try again when you are ready.
passkey.held: This device holds a passkey for this admin already.
passkey.remove.askLast: Remove the passkey added {when}? Nothing else is on: your password alone will sign in, and your recovery codes stop working.
codes.line: Lost your phone or passkey? Sign in with your password and one code; each works once.
codes.new.ask: Get new recovery codes? The ones you have stop working.
signsOut: Any change here signs out every other browser.
